tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250phyag rdor stobs po che rdo rje gtum po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs char 'beb ces bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐/ nub phyogs o rgyan sprul pa'i pho brang du// bstan pa'i bdag po thub dbang bcom ldan 'das// byang sems lha mi'i rig 'dzin rnams kyis bskor// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mchog la gsol ba 'debs// lcang lo can gyi pho brang dam pa na// gsang ba'i bdag po phyag rdor stobs po che// gnod sbyin sde dpon rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor// rig sngags bdag po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// padma 'od kyi pho brang dam pa ru// dregs pa kun 'dul padma thod phreng rtsal// dhā ki rig 'dzin ging chen tshogs kyis bskor// drag rtsal mthu stobs can la gsol ba 'debs// rdo rje gdan mtshungs 'phrul snang gzhal yas su// mnga' bdag yab sras ye shes mtsho rgyal la// rig 'dzin lha dang lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor// smin grol mthar phyin gsum la gsol ba 'debs// rgyal bas lung bstan snang rtse'i gzhal yas su// padma'i gdung 'dzin gar gyi dbang phyug la// dad ldan chos mdzad 'brel ldan tshogs kyis bskor// smin grol dga' ston 'gyed la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol btab thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis// mi mjed khams 'dir bkra shis bde ldan zhing*// bar chad bgegs zhi skyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas// gsang ba'i bdag po'i go 'phang thob par shog /
ces pa 'di sprul sku rin po che bde chen gling pas bskul ba'i ngor rdzogs chen pa gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// //
